thread:
Asha M: Hey team — draft of the product launch post is ready for review. Doc + hero image in the doc: https://docs.google.com/xxxx. Looking for: tone + headline, a short benchmark paragraph (latency/cost), webinar CTA copy, and final inbound lead routing for HubSpot. Goal: publish next Wed.

Marco B: Reviewing now. Quick note — the benchmark paragraph should call out the exact test conditions (model, seq length, batch) so legal is happy. I can pull numbers from the infra run.

Lena (Content): Skimmed the intro. Love the customer quote placement, but recommend 2 headline options: one technical (perf/cost angle) and one product (what customers get). Examples: "Predictable LLM inference at scale" vs "Ship LLM features faster, pay less".

Priya (Demand Gen): For the webinar CTA — we need a single registration link + 3 UTMs: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=launch_q2. Also confirm speakers: Asha + Marco + customer. Can we get a short blurb for the landing page (1 sentence)?

Marco B: Benchmark draft (put in thread so Asha can copy): 
`Test: GPT-small-open, seq=512, batch=8, 8xA10G; median p50=72ms, p95=140ms, cost per 1k tokens = $0.42; ~30% lower unit cost vs baseline config.`

Naomi (Legal): Heads up — avoid absolute superlatives like "best" or "unbeatable" unless we can back them with a public benchmark. Also we need a short privacy pointer for the post (link to privacy + note about data not being retained). Otherwise ok to publish.

Evan (Sales): For lead routing — please tag all webinar registrants with `lead_source=product_launch_may` and set lifecycle stage to `marketing_qualified`. Also add a contact property `interested_in=dedicated` if they check the checkbox on the form. We can prioritize follow-ups that way.

Sam Ops: HubSpot mapping snippet (for whoever's setting the form):
```
form.fields: [ {name: 'email'}, {name: 'company'}, {name: 'interested_in', type: 'checkbox'}, {name: 'utm_campaign', hidden: true} ]
workflow: if utm_campaign == 'launch_q2' -> add to list 'Launch Q2 - Webinar'
```

Priya (Demand Gen): Also ask: localized landing pages for DE and FR? We usually run a translated headline + 1-line local testimonial. Tag translations as `i18n:de, i18n:fr` in the content doc so ops can spin pages.

Lena (Content): I can draft the two headline variants + the 2-line subhead + translated text placeholders by EOD today. For the customer quote, change the bracketed metric to the exact 30% figure Marco mentioned.

Naomi (Legal): Approved language for privacy pointer: "We do not retain or use your demo inputs for training; see our Privacy Policy (link)." That should satisfy compliance for the post.

Marco B: One more note about the benchmark: include a short methods box below the fold with the full config. Avoid including GPU model names in the H1.

Asha M: Thanks — next steps for me: incorporate headline options from Lena, paste Marco's benchmark with the methods box, add the webinar CTA with UTMs (Priya) and share localized copy placeholders. Sam / Ops please confirm the HubSpot workflow snippet is deployable; Evan confirm the MQL tagging mapping. I'll send the final doc to Naomi for sign-off before publish. Target publish: Wed 08:00 PT.

Evan (Sales): Confirmed on tagging. Sam, loop me in when the list is created.

Sam Ops: I can create the workflow. ETA tomorrow morning. Will also export the form JSON for dev.

Asha M: Perfect — dropping a reminder: please add any blocking comments in the doc by EOD today so we can ship to legal tomorrow morning. :pray:

Lena (Content): Will do.

Priya (Demand Gen): Putting webinar landing draft in the shared folder now.

Naomi (Legal): If anything changes on claims, ping me asap.

Marco B: Done with numbers, put final bench table in the doc.

Asha M: Great — thanks everyone.
